## Appearance

Opal Pettigrew is described as the most beautiful girl at the [Academy](../codex/places.md#regent-s-academy), possessing a striking appearance highlighted by big, vivid blue eyes, radiant skin, and lovely blonde hair, which she has worn in a lengthy plait or adorned with red geraniums. Though noted for her vigorous complexion and full, eye-catching shape, she later becomes extremely slender, with hands that appear nearly see-through in their fragility.

_Sources: [v1 CHAPTER XV. A Tempest in the School Teapot P28](../source/v01-c15.md#nw-v01-c15-p0028), [v1 CHAPTER XXX. The Regent’s Class Is Organized P43](../source/v01-c30.md#nw-v01-c30-p0043), [v1 CHAPTER XXXV. The Winter at Regent’s P1](../source/v01-c35.md#nw-v01-c35-p0001), [v1 CHAPTER XXXV. The Winter at Regent’s P6](../source/v01-c35.md#nw-v01-c35-p0006), [v3 ch.Autumn P4](../source/v03-c02.md#nw-v03-c02-p0004), [v3 ch.Life P4](../source/v03-c11.md#nw-v03-c11-p0004), +1 more_

## Personality

Opal Pettigrew possesses a sunny, pleasant disposition, delights openly in the enjoyable aspects of life, and is prone to laughter, though she also tends toward sentimentality and hysteria. Her thoughts and motivations are heavily consumed by romantic pursuits, including plans to secure a boyfriend at age fifteen, teach briefly after qualifying, and entertain dozens of suitors to drive them wild before eventually settling down. Despite her lighthearted focus on male attention and suitors, she harbors intense fears of plump green caterpillars, lying flat and pretending to be deceased on a floating craft, and the unfamiliarity of the afterlife.

_Sources: [v1 CHAPTER XV. A Tempest in the School Teapot P39](../source/v01-c15.md#nw-v01-c15-p0039), [v1 CHAPTER XVIII. Nell to the Rescue P15](../source/v01-c18.md#nw-v01-c18-p0015), [v1 CHAPTER XXIII. Nell Comes to Grief in an Affair of Honor P5](../source/v01-c23.md#nw-v01-c23-p0005), [v1 CHAPTER XXVI. ## History

Opal Pettigrew grew up with numerous older sisters who were quickly married off, having expressed a childhood ambition to possess dozens of suitors. In her youth, she had her warts cured using an enchanted stone from old [Mary Joe](../character/mary-joe.md), and she once hid in a hallway pantry when her sister [Tabitha](../character/tabitha.md) received a marriage proposal from Malcolm Andres. She attended school and Regent's alongside [Nell Harcourt](../character/nell-harcourt.md), and during a past autumn she visited [Boston](../codex/places.md#boston). After Nelson Atkins proposed to her, she returned home and composed a blistering rejection letter. During a break from college, [Nell](../character/nell-harcourt.md) learned from Mrs. Sowerby that Opal was gravely ill with consumption. [Nell](../character/nell-harcourt.md) visited Opal, who tearfully confessed her fear of dying and her unfulfilled desires for her life before passing away peacefully in her sleep shortly thereafter.

_Sources: [v1 CHAPTER XVI. Isolde Is Invited to Tea with Tragic Results P18](../source/v01-c16.md#nw-v01-c16-p0018), [v1 CHAPTER XVIII. Nell to the Rescue P15](../source/v01-c18.md#nw-v01-c18-p0015), [v1 CHAPTER XXVI. The Story Club Is Formed P17](../source/v01-c26.md#nw-v01-c26-p0017), [v2 XXVI Around the Bend P56](../source/v02-c26.md#nw-v02-c26-p0056), [v2 XXVI Around the Bend P58](../source/v02-c26.md#nw-v02-c26-p0058), [v2 XXVI Around the Bend P59](../source/v02-c26.md#nw-v02-c26-p0059), +9 more_

## Quotes

> "It fills me with fear, girls. Is it really proper for us to perform in this manner, do you think? Mrs. Sowerby claims that any drama-acting is dreadfully sinful."
>
> — Opal Pettigrew — [v1 CHAPTER XXVIII. An Unfortunate Lily Maid P13](../source/v01-c28.md#nw-v01-c28-p0013)

> "Nell, the time is drawing near when I will be resting in that place. You, Isolde, and everyone else will be moving around, brimming with vitality—while I will be situated there—within the ancient cemetery—deceased!"
>
> — Opal Pettigrew — [v3 ch.Summons P7](../source/v03-c14.md#nw-v03-c14-p0007)

> "I will endeavor to do so. What you told me will be weighed in my mind, and I will attempt to hold it as true. Also, your visits will be as frequent as possible, will they not, Nell?"
>
> — Opal Pettigrew — [v3 ch.Summons P21](../source/v03-c14.md#nw-v03-c14-p0021)

> "I am aware. Already, you have provided aid to me. At present, nothing appears entirely so terrible. Good night, Nell."
>
> — Opal Pettigrew — [v3 ch.Summons P27](../source/v03-c14.md#nw-v03-c14-p0027)

> "I am pleased that I have shared this with you, Nell,"
>
> — Opal Pettigrew — [v3 ch.Summons P19](../source/v03-c14.md#nw-v03-c14-p0019)
